question: What is the extent of power attributed to the mere knowledge of this practice in the three worlds?
premises: Mere knowledge of it is sufficient.
Nothing is unachievable by that knowledge.
The scope is the three worlds.
inference: By mere knowledge of this, nothing is unachievable in the three worlds.
uncertainties: The antecedent of yasya is not explicitly stated in this verse.
plain_english: By mere knowledge of which, nothing is unachievable in the three worlds.
